import itertools
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
L={'P':P,'1/P':1/P,'P2':P**2,'logP':np.log(P),'expmP':np.exp(-P),'cosP':np.cos(P),'sinP':np.sin(P),'sqrtP':np.sqrt(P),'PlogP':P*np.log(P),'expmP2':np.exp(-P**2),'Pexpmt':P*np.exp(-t),'1/P2':1/P**2,'P3':P**3,'t':t,'expmt':np.exp(-t),'tP':t*P,'1':np.ones_like(P)}
names=list(L.keys())
res=[]
for b in np.linspace(0.55,0.65,101):
    S=np.sin(b*P)*t
    for combo in itertools.combinations(names,2):
        X=np.column_stack([S,L[combo[0]],L[combo[1]]])
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
        rr=y-X@c
        res.append((np.mean(rr**2)/np.var(y),round(b,3),combo,np.round(c,4)))
res.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
for q in res[:8]: print(q)
